university.name: Teesside University
university.summary: Teesside University gives its address as Tees Valley, Middlesbrough TS1 3BX, and also lists Teesside University London at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. It publishes 2026-27 international fees, a Pakistan country page and a portfolio of international scholarships.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 12 months for September or May start, 16 months for January start (full time)
courses.overview: A full-time taught master's for graduates in a related discipline. The page lists seven core modules, including artificial intelligence foundations, machine learning, big data and business intelligence, and a computing masters project.
highlights: Core: Big Data and Business Intelligence
courses.academic_requirements: First degree in a related discipline (2.2 minimum), or relevant experience or equivalent qualifications. Related subjects include artificial intelligence, computer forensics, computer science, computing, information technology, data science and digital forensics.
courses.english_requirements: Course page: IELTS 6.0 or equivalent. Teesside English page (postgraduate computing): IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each band; PTE Academic 59; TOEFL iBT listening 17, reading 18, writing 17, speaking 20 (no overall score given). Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page, postgraduate: a four-year bachelor degree with a minimum mark of 60% or grade-point average of 3.0. Alternatively a two or three-year degree (four years in humanities and commerce) with a minimum of 55% or grade-point average of 2.5, followed by a two-year master's with the same minimum. Scale of the grade-point average is not stated.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 17,000 applies to 2026-27 (fees page, one-year taught MSc). Course page shows January, May or September starts for 2026-27 entry only, so no 2027 intake recorded. Campus is not named on the course page. Module list carries no year and the page says modules may vary.

courses.title: International Business Management
courses.overview: A full-time taught master's in international business management. The page lists five core modules, including sustainable management in global markets, responsible leadership, critical business inquiry and a business project.
highlights: Core: Reimagining Sustainable Management in Global Markets
Core: Contemporary Management in Operations and Finance
courses.academic_requirements: An honours degree (at least a 2:2), a post-experience or professional qualification, or equivalent qualifications including international qualifications.
courses.english_requirements: Course page: IELTS of 6 or equivalent. Teesside English page (postgraduate business, except HRM): IELTS 6.0 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each band; PTE Academic 59; TOEFL iBT listening 17, reading 18, writing 17, speaking 20 (no overall score given). Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page, postgraduate: a four-year bachelor degree with a minimum mark of 60% or grade-point average of 3.0. Alternatively a two or three-year degree (four years in humanities and commerce) with a minimum of 55% or grade-point average of 2.5, followed by a two-year master's with the same minimum. Scale of the grade-point average is not stated.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 17,000 applies to 2026-27. Course page shows January, May or September starts for 2026-27 entry only, so no 2027 intake recorded. Campus is not named on the course page. Page says modules may vary.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years, or 4 with a work placement (full time)
courses.overview: A full-time undergraduate computer science degree. The page lists four core first year modules covering programming, systems design and databases, and secure computers and networks, with an optional work placement year.
courses.academic_requirements: 2027-28 entry: 96 to 112 UCAS points plus maths GCSE grade 4, Level 2 Key Skills (Application of Number) or Level 2 Functional Skills. International applicants are directed to country-specific pages.
courses.english_requirements: Course page gives no scores. Teesside English page (undergraduate computing): IELTS 5.5 overall with a minimum of 5.5 in each band; PTE Academic 59; TOEFL iBT listening 17, reading 18, writing 17, speaking 20 (no overall score given). Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page, undergraduate: Year 1 entry with a two-year bachelor degree with a minimum of 60%; second-year entry with a minimum of 60% from a three-year bachelor degree; third-year entry with a minimum of 60% from a four-year bachelor degree. The page does not describe entry from Pakistani school-level qualifications.
courses.application_deadline_note: 2027 entry applications go through UCAS, per the course page.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 17,000 applies to 2026-27 (standard degree on fees page; the course page gives the figure without a year label). September start with 2027-28 entry requirements is shown; no month and year pairing is stated explicitly for 2027. The course is also offered at Teesside University London with different structure and delivery. Pakistan route does not map to one pk_route value, so pk fields left null.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 7,000 fee waiver in the first year of study; up to 30 awards
scholarships.summary: First year fee waiver for international fee-paying students starting at Teesside for the first time, who submit a personal statement and have paid the deposit and accepted a conditional offer.
scholarships.criteria_text: Genuine international fee-paying student; on campus in Middlesbrough or Darlington; undergraduate or postgraduate taught; personal statement of up to 500 words; not Level 3 foundation or Level 8 doctoral; cannot be combined with other Teesside or Alumni scholarships.
scholarships.deadline_note: Page states applications for the September 2026 round are closed; no date given. 2027 round not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for September 2026 entry only. Pakistan is not named on the page.

scholarships.name: Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 fee waiver for the first full academic year of study
scholarships.summary: Fee waiver for eligible international fee-paying offer-holders, assessed from the course application with reference to prior academic performance. No separate application is stated.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time, sponsored or self-funding student paying international fees; on campus in Middlesbrough or Darlington; must hold an offer by the stated date, pay the deposit and accept the offer; cannot be combined with other Teesside scholarships.
scholarships.deadline_note: For the September 2026 round, applicants had to hold an offer by 30 April 2026. 2027 dates not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are for September 2026 entry only. The page lists eligible countries nowhere; Pakistan is not named. The page contradicts itself on whether Level 3 foundation courses are eligible.

scholarships.name: Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.summary: Fee waiver for international fee-paying Teesside undergraduates progressing to postgraduate study, or master's graduates starting a new postgraduate programme, applied automatically to eligible offer-holders.
scholarships.criteria_text: Direct applicant (must not use an agent); offer for a postgraduate programme; full-time on campus in Middlesbrough or Darlington; paying international fees; Level 8 not eligible. Can be combined with one other Teesside scholarship.
scholarships.notes: Terms taken from the scholarships overview page; no entry year stated. The direct applicant condition (no agent) is quoted from the page.
